information.name: echo-sso
information.description: Single sign-on bridge from the UISP client zone to the Echo messaging application. Clients click through from the portal and land directly in Echo without a separate login.
information.author: LocalSplash

configuration.label: Echo Base URL
configuration.description: Base URL of the Echo application, no trailing slash, e.g. https://echo.example.net

configuration.label: SSO Shared Secret
configuration.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex secret shared with the Echo application (UISP_SSO_SECRET in Echo's environment). Keep this private.
